text.tspan: A reader takes a quiet moment without rushing.
Ten quiet minutes can make a busy morning better. I use this time to enjoy breakfast and read a little.
These two small habits help me start the day calmly.
First, a slow breakfast helps me notice the world around me. I usually leave my phone on the shelf for
ten minutes. I sit by the window and eat slowly. Sometimes I watch birds in the tree outside.
Second, a little reading gives me time for something I enjoy. I read one or two pages after breakfast. I do
not need to finish a whole chapter. I build this habit step by step.
Eating slowly and reading a little make my mornings more enjoyable. My day is still busy, but I have
made time for myself. I want to keep these simple habits.
BUILD YOUR OWN · State a clear main idea; develop two different points with examples; bring them together in the
conclusion. Each body paragraph needs a distinct point and a concrete example. The conclusion should connect the
argument rather than introduce a new proposal.
You want to make a realistic plan, but one thing is difficult. Say what it is and give two ways to help. Use four short
paragraphs: introduction, two developed points, and conclusion. (Model: One possible outline: say what you want to do;
explain the first step; explain a different second step; say why the two steps help.)
